WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what understanding algebraic expressions means in plain words.

INTRODUCTION
----
Understanding Algebraic Expressions. Get clear on algebraic expressions before moving on. How would you explain algebraic expressions to a classmate in one minute? Use this anchor: Form algebraic expressions from real-life situations. Clue from the topic: ● discuss how to form algebraic. Check every example on this page against that anchor.

MAIN NOTES
----
• An algebraic expression uses numbers and letters (variables) joined by operations.
• Like terms have the same variable part — combine them; unlike terms stay separate.
• To solve an equation, undo operations carefully on both sides.
• Check by substituting your answer back into the original equation.
• Example: if x = 4, then 2x + 3 = 11.

Solve for x: x + 8 = 14.

Working:

2. Substitute values: x = 14 − 8
3. x = 6
4. Check: 6 + 8 = 14
Final Answer: x = 6
